headlines.title: Army detonates cache of lead explosives, with toxic plume possible across Iowa
headlines.description: The Army detonated a stockpile of unstable lead azide explosives in Iowa on Wednesday morning. A toxic dust plume could travel for miles.

headlines.title: Too young to be vaccinated for measles? Babies face growing threats from outbreaks
headlines.description: As measles outbreaks continue to soar, a new question has emerged: Should doctors give measles shots earlier to better protect babies?

headlines.title: Army says controlled detonation of lead explosives was ‘a huge success’
headlines.description: After the Army detonated a cache of toxic explosives in Iowa, the Environmental Protection Agency said there is zero detection of airborne lead near the detonation site. NBC News' Shaquille Brewster and Dr. Juanita Mora of the American Lung Association discuss the cleanup plans and safety tips.

headlines.title: Former St. Jude Patient Returns to Aid Next Generation
headlines.description: For three years, radiology technologist Ted VanAusdall has performed CT scans and provided smiles at St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital. But long before he was treating young patients, he was one of them. NBC’s Savannah Sellers reports for TODAY on his cancer journey before he found his way back to help others. Then, Marlo Thomas, the hospital’s national outreach director, shares insights into St. Jude’s life studies.

headlines.title: Israeli tech company develops AI chatbot to triage mental health and PTSD patients
headlines.description: As AI continues to spread into many different industries, one tech company developed an avatar chatbot to help triage and diagnose patients seeking mental health treatments. NBC News’ Keir Simmons spoke with the people at the forefront of the new technology.

headlines.title: Military families fight for fixes to healthcare program
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports for the series “The Cost of Denial” about the military families who say they are receiving bills they shouldn’t - in some cases - even as they are battling terminal illness.

headlines.title: Early Black Friday deals are here, and I’m tracking the 57+ best ones daily: Amazon, Apple, PlayStation and more
headlines.description: Early Black Friday deals are here from Amazon, Apple, Walmart, Target, PlayStation and more. Follow daily updates as our shopping experts find the best sales.

headlines.title: Get the 45+ best Advent calendars of the year before they sell out
headlines.description: Popular Advent calendars sell out before December, so get yours now. Shop the best ones from Bonne Maman, Anthropologie, Squishmallows and more.

headlines.title: Talking Shop with Tyler Cameron
headlines.description: Tyler Cameron’s 2026 was an HGTV and DWTS whirlwind, now he’s sharing the gifts he’s getting his fiance before the year ends and all the things that’ll help him become a “hot dad” in 2027.

headlines.description: Home Depot’s Black Friday sale includes deals on power tools, holiday decorations, appliances, storage and more. Find discounts on brands like Milwaukee, Ring and LG.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.
